_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Temüjin is proclaimed Genghis Khan
events.desc: A great assembly on the Onon river proclaims Temüjin ruler of the united Mongol tribes.

events.label: Mongols begin raiding Western Xia
events.desc: The first Mongol campaigns against a settled state. A full invasion in 1209 forces Western Xia to submit; the state is destroyed in 1227.

events.label: Mongol war against the Jin dynasty begins
events.wiki: Mongol conquest of the Jin dynasty
events.desc: Genghis Khan invades northern China.

events.label: Mongols take Zhongdu
events.desc: The Jin capital Zhongdu (Beijing) falls to the Mongols.
events.check: no Wikidata item for the linked article

events.label: Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire
events.wiki: Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire
events.desc: After the killing of a Mongol caravan and envoys, Genghis Khan invades Khwarazm.

events.label: Bukhara and Samarkand fall
events.desc: The Mongols take the great cities of Transoxiana.

events.label: Battle of the Indus
events.desc: Genghis Khan defeats Jalal al-Din, who escapes across the Indus.

events.label: Battle of the Kalka River
events.desc: Jebe and Subutai defeat an army of Rus' princes and Cumans.

events.label: Death of Genghis Khan
events.desc: Genghis Khan dies during the final campaign against Western Xia.

events.label: Ögedei becomes Great Khan
events.desc: A kurultai confirms Genghis Khan's third son as his successor.

events.label: Jin dynasty falls
events.desc: Mongol and Song forces take the last Jin capital, Caizhou.

events.label: Mongol invasion of Kievan Rus' begins
events.desc: Batu Khan's army takes Ryazan and then the cities of north-eastern Rus'.

events.label: Sack of Kiev
events.desc: The Mongols storm Kiev.

events.label: Battle of Legnica
events.desc: A Mongol force defeats a Polish and German army in Silesia.

events.label: Battle of Mohi
events.desc: Batu and Subutai destroy the Hungarian army; the Mongols withdraw the following year.

events.label: Siege of Baghdad
events.desc: Hulagu's army takes Baghdad and kills the Abbasid caliph.

events.label: Battle of Ain Jalut
events.desc: The Mamluks of Egypt defeat a Mongol army in Palestine.

events.label: Kublai is proclaimed Great Khan
events.desc: Kublai and his brother Ariq Böke both claim the throne; Kublai wins the civil war in 1264.

events.label: Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan dynasty
events.desc: Kublai gives his realm in China a Chinese dynastic name.

events.label: First Mongol invasion of Japan
events.desc: A Yuan and Korean fleet lands in Kyushu and withdraws.

events.label: Battle of Yamen
events.desc: The Yuan fleet destroys the last Song forces; the Song dynasty ends.

events.label: Second Mongol invasion of Japan
events.desc: A much larger invasion fleet is wrecked by a typhoon.

events.label: Death of Kublai Khan
events.desc: Kublai dies; the empire is by now four separate khanates in practice.
